positions.title: Graduate Assistant - Web Technical Support
positions.description: Maintained and assisted in new features for the IST department's website. Developed a front-end and provided plans for a back-end for the department's lab information system. Graded assignments and provided support in the classroom for Client Programming and Web and Mobile II courses. I also held open tutoring hours for students who required assistance in database, web, and/or programming courses.

positions.title: Data Intern
positions.description: Worked Summers (2011-2014) and one school year (2011-1012) as an Intern in the Data Warehouse, running Do Not Solicit and Federal Do Not Call jobs, and doing maintenance on the product hierarchy.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant (Database)
positions.description: Graded assignments and provided support in the classroom for Into to Database and Server-side Programming courses. I also held open tutoring hours for students who required assistance in database, web, and/or programming courses.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer Umpire for Minor League, Little League, and Jr./Sr. League Baseball

volunteerExperiences.companyName: St. John's Episcopal Church, Westfield, PA
volunteerExperiences.description: I have attended St. John's since I was an infant and I have been volunteering there for quite some time. I volunteered to help with church dinners to raise funds for the restoration of the church's stained glass windows and am currently in the process of creating a website for the church in hopes of spreading awareness of their services and functions.
